title: Quiet groups and what you missed
summary: Groups are quiet by default: they notify only for mentions, replies and new polls (ADR 0026). When the person opens a group with unread messages, a block above the first unread message lists what was for them.

kind.description: mention: a message that mentions the person. reply: a reply to the person's message. poll: an open poll the person has not answered. pinned: a message pinned since the last visit. more: the count of other unread messages.

eventId.description: The message the line opens. Absent for more.

text.description: The sender's name, the poll question or the pinned text, or the formatted count for more.

applied.description: The account's group defaults are quiet and the poll rule exists.

missed.description: Built on the device from the unread messages after the fully-read marker, in kind order. Empty hides the block.

applyDefaults.effect: Once per account after sign-in: if the server can push encrypted events and the push rules have no chat.bipe.poll_start rule, sets the default group mode to mentions and keywords only where it is still all messages (encrypted and unencrypted), then adds an override rule chat.bipe.poll_start that notifies for *.poll.start events.

buildMissed.effect: When a group opens with unread messages: scans the loaded unread events and makes the lines.

openLine.effect: Scrolls the timeline to the event. more scrolls to the first unread message.

notes: A person who already picked a group default (not all messages) keeps it. A group the person sets to all messages or mute keeps that (chat-notifications).
The poll rule: NotificationSettings.setCustomPushRule with rule id chat.bipe.poll_start, RuleKind override, action notify, condition event match on type *.poll.start.
Fixed rules on the device, no model, no server change (ADR 0026). Other Matrix apps see a normal room.
"Since the last visit" is the fully-read marker (m.fully_read), the ReadMarker virtual item.
Pinned messages are not shown in phase 1 of the timeline, so the pinned line stays empty until pins ship.
Bipe logic: BipeQuietGroups.run and its rule id chat.bipe.poll_start (Android). Keep the same rule id so a phone that moves from the fork does not add a second rule.
